about.name: Andrei Tolstykh
about.subtitle: Staff Product Designer & Design Technologist
paragraphs: I'm a Product and UI/UX Designer with {yearsExp}+ years of experience designing complex B2B products across Big Tech and startup environments. Currently, I work at an AI startup, where I design a platform for trustworthy and responsible AI. Previously, I worked at one of Eastern Europe's largest FinTech companies, designing a large-scale financial platform and contributing to SAP-based enterprise solutions.

I specialize in simplifying complex workflows and creating scalable product experiences. I collaborate closely with engineers and product teams and have built two large-scale design systems in Storybook.
Using AI-powered CLI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, I develop and maintain these systems and turn their components into functional, high-fidelity prototypes.

experience.description: Lead end-to-end product design, information architecture, and UX strategy for an enterprise AI testing and governance platform.

Designed UI component libraries, responsive layouts, and user workflows supporting bank-wide ERP systems transformation.
Conducted financial forecasting, capital planning, and process analysis across enterprise banking units.
